import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
sns.barplot(x=product_sales.values, y=product_sales.index, palette='viridis', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Product')

# 2. Sales by Age Group
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
sns.barplot(x=age_sales.index, y=age_sales.values, palette='mako', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title('Total Sales by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('Set2'))
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sales by Size
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = size_sales.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_sales.index])
sns.barplot(x=size_sales.index, y=size_sales.values, palette='rocket', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Total Sales by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Size')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')

# 5. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
takeaway_sales = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
ax5.pie(takeaway_sales.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))
ax5.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Sales', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Quantity Distribution
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='quantity', bins=10, kde=True, color='coral', ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Quantity Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Quantity')
ax6.set_ylabel('Frequency')

# 7. Sales Over Time (by hour)
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax7.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='green')
ax7.set_title('Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Hour')
ax7.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 8. Price Distribution
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='price', palette='coolwarm', ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Price Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Price ($)')

# 9. Total Sales Summary
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
ax9.axis('off')
total_revenue = df['total'].sum()
total_orders = len(df)
avg_order = df['total'].mean()
summary_text = f"""
SALES SUMMARY
{'='*25}

Total Revenue: ${total_revenue:.2f}
Total Orders: {total_orders}
Average Order: ${avg_order:.2f}

Top Product: {product_sales.index[0]}
Top Age Group: {age_sales.index[0]}
"""
ax9.text(0.1, 0.5, summary_text, fontsize=12, family='monospace', 
         verticalalignment='center', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
